title: एकादशोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Ashvatthaman pierces Bhima with arrows and the two fight like tigers, each praising the other's skill. In the end Bhima, shaken, is carried away by his charioteer.
summary.kn: ಅಶ್ವತ್ಥಾಮ ಭೀಮನನ್ನು ಬಾಣಗಳಿಂದ ಚುಚ್ಚುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಇಬ್ಬರೂ ಹುಲಿಗಳಂತೆ ಹೋರಾಡುತ್ತಾ ಪರಸ್ಪರ ಕೌಶಲ್ಯ ಹೊಗಳುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಕೊನೆಗೆ ಕಂಗೆಟ್ಟ ಭೀಮನನ್ನು ಸಾರಥಿ ದೂರ ಒಯ್ಯುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: अश्वत्थामा भीम को बाणों से बींधता है और दोनों बाघों की तरह लड़ते हैं, एक-दूसरे के कौशल की प्रशंसा करते हैं। अन्त में विचलित भीम को उनका सारथी हटा ले जाता है।
summary.te: అశ్వత్థామ భీమును బాణాలతో గుచ్చుతాడు; ఇద్దరూ పులుల్లా పోరాడుతూ ఒకరి నైపుణ్యాన్ని ఒకరు పొగుడుతారు. చివరికి కలత చెందిన భీమును సారథి తీసుకెళతాడు.
summary.ta: அஸ்வத்தாமன் பீமனை அம்புகளால் துளைக்க, இருவரும் புலிகள் போல் போரிட்டு ஒருவர் திறமையை மற்றவர் பாராட்டுகின்றனர். இறுதியில் தளர்ந்த பீமனைத் தேரோட்டி அழைத்துச் செல்கிறான்.
summary.ml: അശ്വത്ഥാമാവ് ഭീമനെ അമ്പുകൾകൊണ്ട് തുളയ്ക്കുന്നു; കടുവകളെപ്പോലെ ഇരുവരും പൊരുതുന്നു, ഓരോരുത്തരും മറ്റവന്റെ വിരുതിനെ പ്രശംസിക്കുന്നു. ഒടുവിൽ ഭീമൻ ഇളകിപ്പോയി, സാരഥി അദ്ദേഹത്തെ കൊണ്ടുപോകുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 8.11; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Jul 29 2019

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
भीमसेनं ततो द्रौणी राजन्विव्याध पत्रिणा ।
त्वरया परया युक्तो दर्शयन्नस्त्रलाघवम् ॥

meaning.en: Then Drona's son pierced Bhimasena with an arrow, O king, in great haste, showing his quickness with weapons.

verses.text:
अथैनं पुनराजघ्ने नवत्या निशितैः शरैः ।
सर्वमर्माणि संप्रेक्ष्य मर्मज्ञो लघुहस्तवत् ॥

meaning.en: Then, knowing the vital spots and quick-handed, he struck him again with ninety sharp arrows, aiming at all his weak points.

verses.text:
भीमसेनः समाकीर्णो द्रौणिना निशितैः शरैः ।
रराज समरे राजन्रश्मिवानिव भास्करः ॥

meaning.en: Covered with Drona's son's sharp arrows, Bhimasena shone in the battle, O king, like the sun with its rays.

verses.text:
ततः शरसहस्रेण सुप्रयुक्तेन पाण्डवः ।
द्रोणपुत्रमवच्छाद्य सिंहनादममुञ्चत ॥

meaning.en: Then with a thousand arrows well aimed the Pandava covered Drona's son and let out a lion's roar.

verses.text:
शरैः शरांस्ततो द्रौणिः संवार्य युधि पाण्डवम् ।
ललाटेऽभ्यहनद्राजन्नाराचेन स्मयन्निव ॥

meaning.en: Parrying those arrows with arrows in the battle, Drona's son struck the Pandava on the forehead with an iron arrow, O king, as if smiling.

verses.text:
ललाटस्थं ततो बाणं धारयामास पाण्डवः ।
यथा शृङ्गं वने दृप्तः खड्गो धारयते नृप ॥

meaning.en: The Pandava bore the arrow in his forehead as a proud rhinoceros in the forest bears its horn, O king.

verses.text:
ततो द्रौणिं रणे भीमो यतमानं पराक्रमी ।
त्रिभिर्विव्याध नाराचैर्ललाटे विस्मयन्निव ॥

meaning.en: Then in battle the mighty Bhima, as if in wonder, pierced Drona's son, who was striving, on the forehead with three iron arrows.

verses.text:
ललाटस्थैस्ततो बाणैर्ब्राह्मणः स व्यरोचत ।
प्रावृषीव यथा सिक्तस्त्रिशृङ्गः पर्वतोत्तमः ॥

meaning.en: With the arrows in his forehead the Brahmana shone like a three-peaked best of mountains drenched by the rains.

verses.text:
ततः शरशतैर्द्रौणिमर्दयामास पाण्डवः ।
न चैनं कम्पयामास मातरिश्वेव पर्वतम् ॥

meaning.en: Then the Pandava tormented Drona's son with hundreds of arrows but could not shake him, as the wind cannot shake a mountain.

verses.text:
तथैव पाण्डवं युद्धे द्रौणिः शरशतैः शितैः ।
नाकम्पयत संहृष्टो वार्योघ इव पर्वतम् ॥

meaning.en: In the same way Drona's son, gladdened, with hundreds of sharp arrows could not shake the Pandava in battle, as a flood of water cannot shake a mountain.

verses.text:
तावन्योन्यं शरैर्घोरैश्छादयानौ महारथौ ।
रथचर्यागतौ शूरौ शुशुभाते रणोत्कटौ ॥

meaning.en: Covering each other with terrible arrows, those two great chariot-fighters, heroes eager in battle, shone as they wheeled their chariots.

verses.text:
आदित्याविव संदीप्तौ लोकक्षयकरावुभौ ।
स्वरश्मिभिरिवान्योन्यं तापयन्तौ शरोत्तमैः ॥

meaning.en: Both blazing like two suns that destroy the worlds, they scorched each other with the best arrows as if with their own rays.

verses.text:
कृतप्रतिकृते यत्नं कुर्वाणौ च महारणे ।
कृतप्रतिकृते यत्नं चक्राते तावभीतवत् ॥

meaning.en: Each striving to repay the other's blow in the great battle, they made their effort fearlessly, blow for blow.

verses.text:
व्याघ्राविव च संग्रामे चेरतुस्तौ महारथौ ।
शरदंष्ट्रौ दुराधर्षौ चापव्यात्तौ भयानकौ ॥

meaning.en: The two great chariot-fighters moved in the battle like two tigers, hard to assail, with arrows for fangs and bows for gaping mouths, terrible.

verses.text:
अभूतां तावदृश्यौ च शरजालैः समन्ततः ।
मेघजालैरिव च्छन्नौ गगने चन्द्रभास्करौ ॥

meaning.en: They became invisible, covered on all sides with nets of arrows, like the moon and sun hidden in the sky by masses of cloud.

verses.text:
प्रकाशौ च मुहूर्तेन तत्रैवास्तामरिंदमौ ।
विमुक्तौ मेघजालेन शशिसूर्यौ यथा दिवि ॥

meaning.en: In a moment those tamers of foes shone again there, freed from the cloud mass like moon and sun in the sky.

verses.text:
अपसव्यं ततश्चक्रे द्रौणिस्तत्र वृकोदरम् ।
किरञ्शरशतैरुग्रैर्धाराभिरिव पर्वतम् ॥

meaning.en: Then Drona's son made Vrikodara his left side, scattering hundreds of fierce arrows, as clouds pour streams on a mountain.

verses.text:
न तु तन्ममृषे भीमः शत्रोर्विजयलक्षणम् ।
प्रतिचक्रे च तं राजन्पाण्डवोऽप्यपसव्यतः ॥

meaning.en: But Bhima could not bear that sign of the enemy's superiority, and the Pandava in turn put him on his left, O king.

verses.text:
मण्डलानां विभागेषु गतप्रत्यागतेषु च ।
बभूव तुमुलं युद्धं तयोस्तत्र महामृधे ॥

meaning.en: In the divisions of their circling, advancing and retreating, a tumultuous fight took place between them in that great battle.

verses.text:
चरित्वा विविधान्मार्गान्मण्डलं स्थानमेव च ।
शरैः पूर्णायतोत्सृष्टैरन्योन्यमभिजघ्नतुः ॥

meaning.en: Having moved along various paths, by circles and by standing still, they struck each other with arrows drawn full and loosed.

verses.text:
अन्योन्यस्य वधे यत्नं चक्रतुस्तौ महारथौ ।
ईषतुर्विरथं चैव कर्तुमन्योन्यमाहवे ॥

meaning.en: Those two great chariot-fighters strove to kill each other, and each wished to make the other chariotless in the battle.

verses.text:
ततो द्रौणिर्महास्त्राणि प्रादुश्चक्रे महारथः ।
तान्यस्त्रैरेव समरे प्रतिजघ्नेऽस्य पाण्डवः ॥

meaning.en: Then the great chariot-fighter Drona's son revealed great weapons, and the Pandava countered them with weapons in the battle.

verses.text:
ततो घोरं महाराज अस्त्रयुद्धमवर्तत ।
ग्रहयुद्धं यथा घोरं प्रजासंहरणे अभूत् ॥

meaning.en: Then, great king, a terrible fight of weapons ensued, like a terrible war of planets at the destruction of creatures.

verses.text:
ते बाणाः समसज्जन्त क्षिप्तास्ताभ्यां तु भारत ।
द्योतयन्तो दिशः सर्वास्तच्च सैन्यं समन्ततः ॥

meaning.en: The arrows loosed by those two, O Bharata, clashed together, lighting up all the quarters and that army on every side.

verses.text:
बाणसंघावृतं घोरमाकाशं समपद्यत ।
उक्लापातकृतं यद्वत्प्रजानां संक्षये नृप ॥

meaning.en: The sky became terrible, covered with masses of arrows, like the fall of meteors at the destruction of creatures, O king.

verses.text:
बाणाभिघातात्संजज्ञे तत्र भारत पावकः ।
सविस्फुलिङ्गो दीप्तार्चिः सोऽदहद्वाहिनीद्वयम् ॥

meaning.en: From the striking of the arrows there, O Bharata, a fire arose with sparks and blazing flames, and it burned both armies.

verses.text:
तत्र सिद्धा महाराज संपतन्तोऽब्रुवन्वचः ।
अति युद्धानि सर्वाणि युद्धमेतत्ततोऽधिकम् ॥

meaning.en: There perfected beings, great king, flying past, said: "All other battles are surpassed; this battle is greater still.

verses.text:
सर्वयुद्धानि चैतस्य कलां नार्हन्ति षोडशीम् ।
नैतादृशं पुनर्युद्धं न भूतं न भविष्यति ॥

meaning.en: All battles together do not merit a sixteenth part of this one. There has never been such a battle before, nor will there be.

verses.text:
अहो ज्ञानेन संयुक्तावुभौ चोग्रपराक्रमौ ।
अहो भीमे बलं भीममेतयोश्च कृतास्त्रता ॥

meaning.en: Ah, both are possessed of knowledge and both are fierce in valour. Ah, the terrible strength in Bhima, and how skilled in arms both are!

verses.text:
अहो वीर्यस्य सारत्वमहो सौष्ठवमेतयोः ।
स्थितावेतौ हि समरे कालान्तकयमोपमौ ॥

meaning.en: Ah, the essence of their valour, ah, their skill! These two stand in battle like Time, Death and Yama.

verses.text:
रुद्रौ द्वाविव संभूतौ यथा द्वाविव भास्करौ ।
यमौ वा पुरुषव्याघ्रौ घोररूपाविमौ रणे ॥

meaning.en: They have come into being like two Rudras, like two suns, or like the twin Yamas, these two tigers among men, terrible in battle."

verses.text:
श्रूयन्ते स्म तदा वाचः सिद्धानां वै मुहुर्मुहुः ।
सिंहनादश्च संजज्ञे समेतानां दिवौकसाम् ।
अद्भुतं चाप्यचिन्त्यं च दृष्ट्वा कर्म तयोर्मृधे ॥

meaning.en: The voices of the perfected beings were heard again and again, and a lion's roar arose from the gathered dwellers of heaven, seeing the wondrous and unthinkable deed of those two in the fight.

verses.text:
तौ शूरौ समरे राजन्परस्परकृतागसौ ।
परस्परमुदैक्षेतां क्रोधादुद्वृत्य चक्षुषी ॥

meaning.en: Those two heroes in the battle, each having wronged the other, looked at each other with eyes rolling up in rage.

verses.text:
क्रोधरक्तेक्षणौ तौ तु क्रोधात्प्रस्फुरिताधरौ ।
क्रोधात्संदष्टदशनौ संदष्टदशनच्छदौ ॥

meaning.en: With eyes reddened by anger, lips quivering with anger, teeth clenched in anger and biting their lips,

verses.text:
अन्योन्यं छादयन्तौ स्म शरवृष्ट्या महारथौ ।
शराम्बुधारौ समरे शस्त्रविद्युत्प्रकाशिनौ ॥

meaning.en: the two great chariot-fighters covered each other with showers of arrows; in battle they were like clouds with streams of arrows, lit by lightning flashes of weapons.

verses.text:
तावन्योन्यं ध्वजौ विद्ध्वा सारथी च महारथौ ।
अन्योन्यस्य हयान्विद्ध्वा बिभिदाते परस्परम् ॥

meaning.en: Piercing each other's banners and charioteers, those two great chariot-fighters pierced each other's horses and struck each other.

verses.text:
ततः क्रुद्धौ महाराज बाणौ गृह्य महाहवे ।
उभौ चिक्षिपतुस्तूर्णमन्योन्यस्य वधैषिणौ ॥

meaning.en: Then, enraged, great king, taking arrows in the great fight, they both quickly loosed them, each wishing to kill the other.

verses.text:
तौ सायकौ महाराज द्योतमानौ चमूमुखे ।
आजघ्नाते समासाद्य वज्रवेगौ दुरासदौ ॥

meaning.en: Those two arrows, shining at the head of the army, hard to approach and swift as thunderbolts, struck them when they reached them.

verses.text:
तौ परस्परवेगाच्च शराभ्यां च भृशाहतौ ।
निपेततुर्महावीरौ स्वरथोपस्थयोस्तदा ॥

meaning.en: Hit hard by the force of each other and by the two arrows, the two great heroes then fell on the seats of their own chariots.

verses.text:
ततस्तु सारथिर्ज्ञात्वा द्रोणपुत्रमचेतनम् ।
अपोवाह रणाद्राजन्सर्वक्षत्रस्य पश्यतः ॥

meaning.en: Then the charioteer, knowing Drona's son to be unconscious, carried him out of the battle, O king, while all the kshatriyas watched.

verses.text:
तथैव पाण्डवं राजन्विह्वलन्तं मुहुर्मुहुः ।
अपोवाह रथेनाजौ सारथिः शत्रुतापनम् ॥

meaning.en: Likewise, O king, the charioteer carried off in his chariot the Pandava, scorcher of foes, who was repeatedly faltering, from the battle.
